report.advertisedClaim: The advertised claim is unverified. The user states Delta's site says 'no change fees' for Basic Economy, but the official offer page does not clearly state this for Basic Economy. Instead, it emphasizes no changes or refunds after the Risk-Free Cancellation period.
report.policyFinding: Delta's official policy states that Basic Economy tickets are nonrefundable and not changeable after the 24-hour Risk-Free Cancellation period. If you cancel after 24 hours, you will not receive a cash refund. Instead, you may receive an eCredit for future travel, minus a cancellation fee (typically $99 or $199 depending on route). No full cash refund is available after 24 hours unless required by law or in special circumstances (e.g., serious illness, schedule change).
report.explanation: Delta Basic Economy tickets are only eligible for a full cash refund if canceled within 24 hours of booking (Risk-Free Cancellation). After that, you cannot get a cash refund. If you cancel, you may receive an eCredit for future travel, minus a cancellation fee. The 'no change fees' language does not apply to Basic Economy in the way it does for higher fare classes; Basic Economy is generally not changeable or refundable after the 24-hour window.
importantConditions: Full cash refund only within 24 hours of booking (Risk-Free Cancellation).
After 24 hours, Basic Economy is nonrefundable and not changeable.
If canceled after 24 hours, you may receive an eCredit minus a cancellation fee ($99 or $199 depending on route).
No full cash refund after 24 hours unless required by law or in special circumstances.

evidence.excerpt: Ticket changes or refunds not allowed after the Risk-Free Cancellation period. Basic Economy travelers are not eligible for paid or complimentary access or upgrades to premium seats, including to Delta Comfort+® or Preferred Seats.
Note: Customers who purchase Delta Main Basic (Basic Economy) will not be able to change or refund their ticket after the Risk-Free Cancellation period.
You may change or cancel a Basic ticket in most cases, but a fee will be deducted from the value of your ticket. The remaining value will be issued back to you as an eCredit.

unansweredQuestions: Does Delta ever offer exceptions for full refunds on Basic Economy outside the 24-hour window (e.g., for medical emergencies)?
nextSteps: If you need a refundable ticket, consider booking Main Cabin or higher fare classes.
If you booked within the last 24 hours, cancel immediately for a full cash refund.
If outside 24 hours, expect only an eCredit minus a cancellation fee if you cancel.
